## MCP tools (19)

Registered in `apps/hub/src/mcp/server.ts` and reachable over the Streamable HTTP MCP endpoint
with an ACTIVE `MODEL_MCP` session ticket.

| Tool | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `crossagent_ack_message` | Explicitly mark transport delivery, acknowledgement, processing, or response. |
| `crossagent_check_inbox` | Read unread or action-required messages for this agent/session. |
| `crossagent_claim_task` | Atomically claim a task with optimistic concurrency. |
| `crossagent_create_task` | Create a structured task linked to an objective or milestone. |
| `crossagent_delegate_instruction` | Assign work under an active Dashboard-created delegation grant. USER_DELEGATED is limited by the grant's delegator, target, action, scope, priority, version, and expiry; out-of-scope requests are automatically stored and delivered as unsigned AGENT_PROPOSAL. |
| `crossagent_get_context` | Get a deterministic bounded Context Pack relevant to this session and task. |
| `crossagent_get_directive` | Read a structured directive bundle in this Agent's audience. This MCP read never labels verification as VALID; target Adapters verify before model injection. |
| `crossagent_get_thread` | Read one collaboration thread with messages and archived decisions. |
| `crossagent_join` | Select an already registered project by stable UUID, or register/join one by working directory. |
| `crossagent_list_tasks` | List project tasks, optionally limited to deterministically ready work. |
| `crossagent_post_message` | Post substantive collaboration information and reuse threads for replies. |
| `crossagent_publish_artifact` | Publish a bounded evidence artifact without exposing arbitrary files. |
| `crossagent_relay_user_directive` | Relay an exact UTF-16 slice of an immutable captured user turn. Only a whole-turn quote can receive a signed USER_ATTESTED v2 attestation; partial quotes are delivered as AGENT_PROPOSAL with PARTIAL_QUOTE_CONTEXT_UNPROVEN. Relay interpretation is always non-authoritative. |
| `crossagent_request_review` | Freeze a Git snapshot and request peer review. Keep it under 20 changed files; a larger snapshot is reviewed thinner, not harder. |
| `crossagent_resolve_finding` | Respond to, fix, verify, dispute, or explicitly waive a review finding. |
| `crossagent_set_write_intent` | Declare files, globs, and symbols before editing; returns deterministic overlaps. |
| `crossagent_submit_review` | Start a review, add a concrete finding, or submit the final verdict. Check concurrency and scope first: 8 of this project's 11 blocking findings came from those two. |
| `crossagent_update_task` | Update task state or summary while enforcing the state machine and review gate. |
| `crossagent_update_todo` | Create or update structured TODO evidence for a task. |
